provider_contract.request_identity: For scientific logical close C, request exactly one provider kline with startTime=C-1h, endTime=C-1ms, limit=1.
provider_contract.response_identity: Exactly one 12-field row must be returned and its provider open/close timestamps must match the requested hour exactly.

qualification_mode.pull_request: synthetic/injected transport only on GitHub-hosted runner; no real provider access and no self-hosted execution
qualification_mode.post_merge_live_probe: one local operator-run non-scientific connectivity/shape probe from a clean detached worktree at the exact recorded canonical master SHA on a trusted non-US host; use the latest fully completed hour and print no price/volume/feature values

qualification_deviation.post_merge_p1: The source seam must recheck wall-clock time during, after, and on source failures inside the five-request batch so an acquisition crossing the frozen deadline cannot stage late rows or omit the terminal WINDOW_MISSED state.

acceptance: recorder qualification PASS receipt is exact and recorder source is unchanged from its canonical qualification merge
exact request bounds and symbol/interval/limit are machine tested
late scientific hour becomes WINDOW_MISSED without any provider request
a provider request that returns after the recording deadline becomes WINDOW_MISSED and stops further provider requests
a provider request that fails after the recording deadline becomes WINDOW_MISSED while the same failure inside the window remains fail-closed
PR CI performs no real provider access and no repository workflow targets a self-hosted source-probe runner
the post-merge live probe is run only from a clean detached worktree whose HEAD equals the exact recorded canonical master SHA
one post-repair local canonical-SHA probe succeeds for all five symbols on a trusted non-US host without printing scientific values
